title: Classic Harbor Line Key West
specs: Children ages 3 and younger ride for free on all of our sails, but you’ll still need to enter the appropriate number of Infant tickets labeled “Free” when purchasing.
Is food served during the sails? >Food and alcohol packages are available for purchase during the sail.
Guests who bring unauthorized alcohol aboard may be turned away or be asked to leave the alcohol at the dock.
Children ages 2 and younger ride for free on all of our trips.
The name listed on your credit card must be identical to the contact name listed on your booking.
What type of ticket should I buy if I'm bringing a very young child? >For children ages 2-12, you should purchase a reduced price Child ticket.
Should I bring those? >No, it is illegal for you to bring alcohol of your own on board.
America 2.0 features teak decks, mahogany-trimmings, and just under 3600 square feet of canvas!
Should I bring those? >Please do not bring any outside alcohol on board.
We are a licensed bar, so any alcohol consumed on the boat must be purchased from Classic Harbor Line.
